title: Assertion: A Before B
constraints: Rule: `b` may be high only if `a` has been high at some earlier edge since the last reset (not the same cycle).
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: A sticky flag in the checker: `seen_a <= seen_a | a;` (cleared by reset).
`assert property (... b |-> seen_a)`: the assertion samples the flag's pre-edge value, so the same cycle does not count.
Checkers may contain modeling code. That is normal and not part of any design.

examples.check: violation: a and b in the same cycle
examples.title: same cycle
examples.input: a and b together as the first event
